entries.title: Domino Cascade Reaction Chain Room
entries.description: A bright room filled with color-coded domino lines that branch, split, and merge; hitting one domino triggers chained collapses, swinging gates, falling ramps, and bouncing balls with labels and faint motion trails.

entries.title: Chemical Reaction Chain in a Transparent Beaker
entries.description: Colored spheres representing molecules float and collide inside a clear beaker, where certain collisions cause molecules to split, merge, or change color, propagating a visible reaction wave through the fluid with tiny particle bursts.

entries.title: Nuclear Fission Chain in a Crystal Lattice
entries.description: A 3D lattice of pale spheres (uranium atoms) releases glowing green neutrons when a few central atoms fission, with neutrons bouncing and colliding to trigger new fissions, each labeled and leaving fading glow trails.

entries.title: Forest Fire Reaction Chain Across a Terrain
entries.description: A light-colored landscape with trees as vertical cylinders that ignite one by one; flames spread via glowing particles carried by wind, where each burning tree can trigger nearby trees to ignite, leaving charred, darkened trunks.
